SELECT json_build_object(
      'creation', (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM
        (SELECT order_creation_id AS attempt_id, order_id, status, delivery_id, failure_reason,
                failure_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
         FROM order_schema.p_order_creations WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2') c),
      'allOrders', (SELECT count(*) FROM order_schema.p_orders WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2'),
      'activeOrders', (SELECT count(*) FROM order_schema.p_orders WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2' AND deleted_at IS NULL),
      'allDeliveries', (SELECT count(*) FROM delivery_schema.p_deliveries WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2'),
      'activeDeliveries', (SELECT count(*) FROM delivery_schema.p_deliveries WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2' AND deleted_at IS NULL),
      'deliveries', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(d), '[]') FROM
        (SELECT delivery_id, order_id, status, deleted_at FROM delivery_schema.p_deliveries WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2') d),
      'activeRoutes', (SELECT count(*) FROM delivery_schema.p_delivery_routes r JOIN delivery_schema.p_deliveries d
        ON r.delivery_id=d.delivery_id WHERE d.order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL),
      'closures', (SELECT count(*) FROM delivery_schema.p_delivery_creation_closures WHERE order_id='160b53dc-390e-4c1b-b547-123e324dfec2'))
